name: Paysafe Limited
summary: Paysafe Limited provides digital payment solutions in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Merchant Solutions and Digital Wallets. The Merchant Solutions segment offers payment acceptance and transaction processing solutions for merchants and integrated service providers, including merchant acquiring, transaction processing, gateway solutions, fraud and risk management tools, data and analytics, point of sale systems, and merchant financing solutions, as well as support services under the Paysafe and Petroleum Card Services brands.
